notes: 12 is the observed run length including track requests, one rejected motion, stop and finish; not a minimum motion count.
Existing finish terminates the episode; a return transition is not implemented or run.
Raw early turns are truncated, but current cumulative odometry remains. Logged private reasoning has only counts, so no claim that all old facts are forgotten.

2_start_visibility.scope: Actual logged baseline blue-stop poses. All ground points within 1m of the start have negative optical depth even after +/-0.6rad. Existing goal objects can remain visible but are not home markers.
limitations: No unique home descriptor is present; checker texture is repetitive.
Robot joints were not logged: frozen model uses default joints and logged body pose; behind-camera disk proof does not depend on joints.
This is offline geometry using archived GT for diagnostics, not a navigation implementation.

gaps: Runner has call arguments and full measured signed translation/yaw, but adapter receives only results and discards arguments/full vector/yaw.
Initial observation has zero tracked points. First selected point belongs to the blue goal, not a home landmark.
TrackedPoint.world is internal 3D; track_point/get_geometry expose only XY, and memory objects store two coordinates.
No saved origin landmark descriptor/relocalization path; visual_feature is only image_id/pixel_uv.
Current planner packet omits the action ledger and filters stale home candidates; no route/old-landmark retrieval tool exists.

first_selected_point_offline_identity.method: Diagnostic MuJoCo ray at the logged initial pixel; not data available to memory/planner

4_independent_scoring.origin_definition: First Harness capture after 1s initialization settling, not nominal reset [0,0].
required_phase_and_stop_gates: Only then evaluate return distance <=1m, stopped speed<0.12m/s, abs yaw rate<0.25rad/s, no collision/fall over the whole round.
Do not count the initial pose inside the 1m disk as return success; model finish is only a declaration.
4_independent_scoring.interpretation: 1m is a meaningful coarse return region, not precise pose or visual relocalization. Independent GT scoring remains meaningful even if navigation drifts.

navigation.recommended_if_data_were_complete: Measured-motion dead reckoning as primary; visual corrections only after real home landmarks are saved and relocalization is supported.
navigation.command_inverse_only: Technically can issue inverse bounded move_relative/turn commands, but requested displacement differs from measured travel; full directional measured ledger and frame composition are required, not scalar length sums.
navigation.visual_homing_current_status: Unavailable: no initial home track, no exposed XYZ, no distinctive saved descriptor or lost-track relocalization, and stale landmarks are filtered.
navigation.combined_current_status: Not supported by current memory state and tools without additional data plumbing/retrieval/relocalization. No changes made.

public_current_odometry_bypass.source_audit: backend.capture uses _base_pose(); Harness.observation subtracts initial ground-truth base pose and rotates into initial yaw. Both H0 and H2 receive this ideal cumulative odometry.

navigation.GT_boundary_note: Public sensor/tool feedback is permitted by the existing interface. Simulator-derived measurements do not by themselves mean secret evaluator-GT access. The ideal cumulative start-relative pose nevertheless bypasses memory and makes this unsuitable as a memory-necessity or realistic drift test.

drift.critical_distinction: Execution tracking error is not odometry measurement drift. Signed measured feedback and cumulative odometry are computed from ideal simulator poses, not a noisy estimator.
drift.risk_assessment: Command-only integration already differs by about 0.30m outbound; blindly reversing commands has no guaranteed round-trip bound. Current ideal measured feedback removes observed motion accumulation error, except stop/finish settling not included in motion results. One seed/outbound log cannot estimate return noise, covariance or success probability. A 1m independent scoring disk remains meaningful but broad; current GT-derived cumulative odometry makes it an easy closed-loop signal for H0 as well.

reasons: Required directional command/result memory ledger is incomplete in current adapter.
Initial home tracks with exposed 3D position do not exist, and visual home relocalization/retrieval is missing.

Current H0 already receives ideal start-relative cumulative pose through its permitted public sensor interface, so history truncation does not establish external-memory necessity. If GT-only-scoring is intended to exclude this ideal cumulative channel, the current observation contract also fails that stricter condition.
